Name: Stardew Anti-Cheat
Author: Olwtelet
Description:
[center]
[size=6][color=#f5a623][b]🛡️ STARDEW ANTI-CHEAT[/b][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Your farm. Your rules.[/b][/size]
[i]Multiplayer integrity tools for Stardew Valley co-op.[/i]
[/center]

[line]

[quote]
💡 [b]Stardew Valley isn't PvP — and this mod isn't trying to make it PvP.[/b]

It's an optional tool for hosts who want more visibility and control over public farms, community servers, events and controlled modpacks.[/quote]
[heading]✨ WHAT DOES IT DO?[/heading]

Stardew Anti-Cheat watches multiplayer activity from the [b]host side[/b] and can flag unusual or impossible behavior.

[list]
[*]💰 [b]Money[/b] — suspicious increases[/*]
[*]🎒 [b]Inventory[/b] — impossible gains and item spawning[/*]
[*]🏃 [b]Movement[/b] — abnormal speed[/*]
[*]⚡ [b]Energy[/b] — impossible values or regeneration[/*]
[*]⭐ [b]Skills & XP[/b] — unusual progression[/*]
[*]⚔️ [b]Combat[/b] — suspicious activity[/*]
[*]📬 [b]Progression[/b] — unusual game-state changes[/*]
[/list]
[center]
[color=#f5a623][b]Suspicious ≠ Guilty[/b][/color]

The mod uses a [b]suspicion score[/b] and records evidence so the host can decide what actually matters.
[/center]

[line]

[heading]🔍 MOD VERIFICATION[/heading]

When a player joins, the host can check:

[list]
[*]SMAPI mod information[/*]
[*]Mod IDs and versions[/*]
[*]Anti-Cheat client reports[/*]
[*]Optional file fingerprints[/*]
[*]Periodic connection status[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#63c174]● ReportOnly[/color][/b] — detect and log only 
[b][color=#e1b12c]● Blacklist[/color][/b] — flag prohibited mods 
[b][color=#3498db]● Whitelist[/color][/b] — approved mods only 
[b][color=#e74c3c]● Strict[/color][/b] — stronger verification

[quote]
[b]Recommended for first-time users:[/b] start with [color=#63c174][b]ReportOnly[/b][/color].

Nobody is automatically kicked or banned by default.[/quote]
[line]

[heading]🖥️ IN-GAME HOST PANEL[/heading]

[center]
[size=5][b]Press F9[/b][/size]
[/center]

View:

[center]
[b]PLAYERS • MODS • MONEY • ENERGY • INVENTORY
SKILLS • LOCATION • SUSPICION • VIOLATIONS[/b]
[/center]

Host actions include:

[center]
[b]✓ APPROVE  ↻ RE-VERIFY  ✕ KICK  ⛔ DENYLIST  📄 EXPORT LOGS[/b]
[/center]

Farmhands get their own [b]read-only status panel[/b] showing whether their verification and connection are working.

[line]

[heading]🔐 PRIVACY FIRST[/heading]

[center]
[size=4][b]No cloud. No external account. No external server required.[/b][/size]

Security information and logs stay on the [b]host's computer[/b].
[/center]

[line]

[heading]⚠️ NO FAKE PROMISES[/heading]

Stardew Valley wasn't built as a competitive server-authoritative game.

That means no anti-cheat can make cheating completely impossible.

[b]This mod doesn't pretend otherwise.[/b]

Its purpose is simple:

[center]
[size=4][color=#f5a623][b]
MAKE COMMON CHEATING HARDER TO HIDE.
GIVE THE HOST BETTER INFORMATION.
LET THE HOST DECIDE.
[/b][/color][/size]
[/center]

[spoiler]
[b]A few technical limitations:[/b]

[list]
[*]Farmhand health can't be reliably validated host-side.[/*]
[*]Shared money can make exact player attribution harder.[/*]
[*]Combat detection is less reliable than money or inventory checks.[/*]
[*]A sufficiently modified client may falsify client-reported information.[/*]
[*]The host itself is trusted.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[line]

[heading]📥 REQUIREMENTS[/heading]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley:[/b] 1.6.x[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI:[/b] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]✅ No Harmony required[/*]
[*]✅ No additional runtime dependency[/*]
[/list]
For complete verification, install Stardew Anti-Cheat on both the [b]host and farmhands[/b].

[line]

[heading]🧰 QUICK START[/heading]

[b]1.[/b] Install the mod 
[b]2.[/b] Start a multiplayer farm 
[b]3.[/b] Keep [color=#63c174][b]ReportOnly[/b][/color] enabled 
[b]4.[/b] Press [b]F9[/b]
[b]5.[/b] Play normally and review the results 

For large modpacks:

 
[code]ac_makewhitelist[/code]
Automatically generates a whitelist from the host's installed mods.

[line]

[heading]🔓 100% OPEN SOURCE[/heading]

[center]
Want to know exactly what the DLL is doing?

[size=4][url=https://github.com/Olwtelet/Stardew-Anti-Cheat][b]💻 VIEW THE FULL SOURCE CODE ON GITHUB[/b][/url][/size]

[url=https://github.com/Olwtelet/Stardew-Anti-Cheat]github.com/Olwtelet/Stardew-Anti-Cheat[/url]

[b]Bug reports • Testing • Feedback • Contributions welcome[/b]
[/center]

[line]

[center]
[size=5][color=#f5a623][b]🛡️ YOUR FARM. YOUR RULES.[/b][/color][/size]

[i]Start with ReportOnly. Check the evidence.
Tune it for your modpack. Then decide how strict you want your farm to be.[/i]

❤️ [b]Built for the Stardew Valley multiplayer community.[/b]
[/center]
